items.title: Nile Rodgers Defends AI Use in Music Video: 'We Created Everything ... The AI Did What We Told It to Do'
items.excerpt: Nile Rodgers defended the AI-generated visuals in an upcoming Christmas charity music video after fan backlash, saying the team created everything and the AI only executed their direction.

items.title: “Drop the slop dude! Not very chic!”: Nile Rodgers’ AI-generated video leads to heated tech debate
items.excerpt: MusicRadar unpacks the online fight over Nile Rodgers' AI-generated music video and his 'you use tech too' rebuttal, arguing he underestimated public anger at AI visuals.

items.title: Nile Rodgers Becomes the Latest Musician to Support AI
items.excerpt: Digital Music News places Rodgers' defence of his AI-made charity video alongside other high-profile artists embracing generative tools.

items.title: Apple Logic Pro 13 out now: redesigned DAW UI, new browser, and AI not for everyone
items.excerpt: Logic Pro 13 is now publicly released with a redesigned interface, a smart sound browser and the natural-language Intelligent Assistant that can create tracks, open plugins and set levels. Off-list: allowed outlets had no release-day piece (only the 10-28 announcement).

items.title: Paid $200 for Logic Pro? Apple Says You Won't Get This New Feature
items.excerpt: Apple's Logic Pro 13.0 release notes confirm the AI Intelligent Assistant needs an Apple Creator Studio subscription ($12.99/mo) and is not included in the $199.99 one-time purchase. Off-list, same gap as above.

items.title: Grimes is going to star in an AI movie that's coming to theaters
items.excerpt: Grimes joins the cast of Gods Don't Give Gifts, a fully AI-generated sci-fi anthology film getting a US theatrical release in December.

items.title: Grimes Joins AI-Generated Sci-Fi Film Gods Don't Give Gifts
items.excerpt: Grimes has joined the cast of Gods Don't Give Gifts, an AI-generated sci-fi film arriving in US theaters on December 4th.

items.title: From Ticketing To Vocals, The 'Mind-Blowing' Ways Concerts Are Using AI
items.excerpt: Billboard surveys how live music is deploying AI across marketing, ticketing, stage production and live vocal processing.

items.title: How IFPI CEO Victoria Oakley Is Tackling AI & Streaming Fraud Head-On
items.excerpt: IFPI CEO Victoria Oakley on AI training licences, AI-driven streaming fraud and the collaborative process she says the industry needs.

items.title: 'A Vast Landgrab': ICMP Weighs in on Big AI's Australian Copyright Battleground
items.excerpt: ICMP's John Phelan on AI companies' push for a text-and-data-mining exception in Australia and what it means for music publishers.

items.title: Mashup Edu's AI-agent Nia is designed to 'run the business side' of indie acts' careers
items.excerpt: Indian music-education platform Mashup Edu launches Nia, an AI agent that handles release planning and admin for independent artists.

items.title: Mods for everyone: inMusic is opening up MPC, more new gear to coders
items.excerpt: inMusic (Akai, Moog, Numark, Denon) says many of its 22 NAMM launches will be open to modders, extending the 'vibe-coded' AI-assisted MPC mod approach across its brands.

items.title: How Akai and Moog are embracing vibe-coded mods
items.excerpt: inMusic is making open-source MPCs and hackable synths, inviting users to build firmware mods with AI coding tools.

items.title: Cubase 16 adds six-part stem separation and AI vocals
items.excerpt: Steinberg's Cubase 16 adds six-stem separation and Yamaha's upgraded Omnivocal AI singing synthesizer, plus instrument layering. Off-list: allowed outlets' Cubase 16 pieces barely mention the AI features.

items.title: NewJeans' Contract Reportedly Gives Label Right to Use AI-Generated Versions of Their Voices
items.excerpt: A New York Times report on NewJeans' ADOR contracts says the label holds indefinite rights to AI-generated versions of the members' voices and likenesses. Off-list: Pitchfork's version omits the AI clause.

items.title: 아이돌 뺨치는 AI 음악의 인기 롱런…머무르 "누구나 공감할 질문 담았죠"
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI 음악 앱으로 만든 머무르의 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'가 아이돌 신곡 공세 속에서도 음원·노래방 차트 상위권을 지키고 있다. Off-list Korean source.

items.title: 인공지능이 작곡, 로봇이 춤…저작권은 누구 것?
items.excerpt: AI 작곡 음악의 완성도가 높아지면서 AI 음악과 로봇 공연의 저작권 귀속 문제가 쟁점으로 떠오르고 있다. Off-list Korean source.

items.title: AI 음악산업 성장 방안 찾는다… 저작권협회 정책 간담회
items.excerpt: (사)AI음악저작권협회가 AI 작곡·편곡, 음성 합성, 자동 마스터링이 음악 산업의 생산·유통 구조에 미치는 영향을 논의하는 정책 간담회를 열었다. Off-list Korean; page shows date only, time from Google News.

items.title: The Edge asked AI to come up with a U2 song: 'They couldn't' says guitarist
items.excerpt: The Edge says AI can write a formulaic country song, but couldn't produce a U2 song when he tried.

items.title: With artificial intelligence on COP31 agenda, IMPALA calls for action on AI and sustainability
items.excerpt: Ahead of COP31, indie-label body IMPALA calls on the music sector and governments to work together on AI and sustainability. Off-list; page shows date only, time from Google News.

items.title: Wendy's Fans Question Authenticity of Emo Album Amid AI Controversy
items.excerpt: Wendy's brand emo album faces backlash after a YouTuber questioned whether its sound was AI-generated. Off-list.
